fact: Ouest Tribune reports that ANIE's interim president Karim Khalfan launched a digital platform for revising and tracking electoral lists in Oran on 27 October 2025, Oran being the pilot site before generalisation nationwide.
system: ANIE plateforme numérique de révision des listes électorales

fact: ANIE president Mohamed Charfi said that digitising registration operations helped remove nearly one million duplicate registrations from the electoral file between 2021 and 2023, with the electorate put at 23,240,286 after the revision closed on 5 December 2023.
The ANIE president said the national voter file was digitised in 2019 and is updated at each revision.
